calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, divide the trailing five-session log return by its trailing 30-session downside volatility (standard deviation of negative daily log returns, requiring at least 15 downside observations), then lag the signal by one completed session. Higher values indicate stronger momentum per unit downside risk.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC passed the benchmark gates (absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840). Chronological thirds of the 10-day IC series were +0.08095, -0.01117, and +0.05824, indicating regime variation; interpret conservatively given average cross-section near the eight-name minimum.
